result.reason: The redline creates a clear professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, an applicable-laws undertaking, and an at-cost re-performance remedy. The Article 13 disclaimer does not negate these additions because it expressly excepts warranties otherwise stated in Article 13. However, neither level is satisfied because the operative language omits the required service duration, the deliverables/software documentation-conformance and malicious-code warranties, the software warranty duration, and the replacement and refund remedies. It is not minimal to a complete playbook position because it fails to reach either level and also adds distinct qualified-personnel, Protocols, and GCP requirements. Existing provisions remain operative and no direct contradiction is introduced.
